items.quote:
To Dr. Dave and the Staff at David Porter Family Dentistry—
Thank you for making my experience so nice when I got 6 crowns!!!! From the hand cream to the foot massage—I felt so at ease and special. You all went above and beyond. And to Dr. Dave---What a magnificent job. You are so great! Thank you all. I love my teeth!

Everyone at Dr. Porter’s office from Dr. David Porter to the receptionists—are friendly and helpful. They are truly concerned about your dental health, listen and respond to your concerns, and don’t give up until issues are resolved, all in a professional, courteous manner. I especially love Cheryl and always joke with her and give her a hard time, just like she gives it back.
